ai.overview: The Wildcats have defended the belt once in their current reign and will look to extend it against a Friars squad that has held the hardware twice before. This marks the first time these programs have ever met with the belt on the line.
key_matchups: Arizona's 5-game winning streak meets Providence's 4-game surge in a clash of hot teams
The all-time head-to-head stands dead even at 3-3 across 6 meetings, with Providence winning the last encounter 69-65 in 2015
Both teams enter at 5-1, but Arizona's recent wins include impressive performances against UConn and Auburn
ai.betting_angles: Arizona has been rolling with five straight wins, including an 85-79 victory over UConn and an 80-69 road win at Auburn. Providence counters with four consecutive victories, most recently 72-66 over VCU and 67-53 over Colorado. Our Elo model gives Arizona a clear edge despite the even 3-3 all-time series.
ai.prediction_writeup: Arizona's current form is exceptional, with five straight wins including quality victories over UConn and at Auburn. The Wildcats have been scoring efficiently, posting 96, 85, 80, 90, and 104 points in their last five outings. While Providence has won four straight and matches Arizona's 5-1 record, the Friars' recent opponents haven't matched the caliber of Arizona's schedule. The Elo model's clear edge for Arizona, combined with their offensive firepower, suggests the Wildcats keep the belt on this neutral court.
